records.title: Joinery Loom — six-mode tactile placement
records.player_scenario: Player selects a timber post, drags its translucent ghost near a wall anchor, holds a precision modifier to nudge 5 cm, switches to freeform when a socket is unsuitable, and commits or cancels without losing materials.

controls.keyboard_mouse: Left-click pick/confirm, right-click cancel, wheel rotate, Shift precision, Tab cycle mode, Ctrl+Z undo.
controls.controller: Left stick moves ghost on plane, right stick rotates, shoulder cycles mode, A confirms, B cancels, D-pad nudges.
controls.touch: Tap select, drag ghost, two-finger rotate, visible precision/snap toggles, confirm/cancel buttons; never rely on long-press alone.

records.acceptance_negative: Zero wood, occupied anchor, unsupported freeform, invalid mode, NaN transform and rapid double confirm must reject without mutation.
records.acceptance_positive: Given 2 wood and valid post anchor, preview costs 2 but inventory unchanged until confirm; confirm places exactly one post and deducts 2 wood.
